organizations.name: Google DeepMind
organizations.subsegment: Robot foundation models (VLA, embodied reasoning, world models)
organizations.deployment_note: Gemini Robotics offered to trusted testers; Gemini Robotics-ER 1.5 available via Gemini API (preview)
organizations.summary: Google's AI lab (HQ London) that develops the Gemini Robotics VLA/embodied-reasoning models, the RT series, Genie world models and the MuJoCo simulator.

organizations.name: Physical Intelligence
organizations.funding_note: ~$70M seed (Mar 2024), $400M (Nov 2024, $2.4B post), $600M led by CapitalG (Nov 2025, $5.6B) — press-reported; 2026 Series C talks (~$11B) unconfirmed
organizations.deployment_note: Models released for research; open weights (openpi)
organizations.summary: San Francisco startup building general-purpose robot foundation models (π0, π0.5, π*0.6), several released as open weights via openpi.

organizations.name: Skild AI
organizations.funding_note: $300M Series A at $1.5B (Jul 2024); Series B SoftBank-backed (~$4.5–4.7B, 2025); ~$1.4B Series C led by SoftBank at >$14B (Jan 2026). CEO says >$2B raised total (press-reported)
organizations.summary: Pittsburgh-based startup building Skild Brain, a general-purpose robot foundation model intended to run across robot embodiments.

organizations.name: FieldAI
organizations.summary: Irvine, CA startup developing Field Foundation Models that give robots autonomy in unstructured industrial and outdoor environments.

organizations.name: Intrinsic
organizations.ai_approach: AI-assisted robot programming (Flowstate) with Gemini models
organizations.summary: Robotics software company spun out of Alphabet's X in 2021; builds the Flowstate platform and joined Google as a distinct unit in Feb 2026.

organizations.name: Hugging Face
organizations.deployment_note: LeRobot open source; Reachy 2 humanoid via Pollen Robotics
organizations.summary: Open-source AI platform company (NYC/Paris) whose LeRobot library and SmolVLA model are widely used for open robot learning; acquired Pollen Robotics in 2025.

organizations.name: OpenAI
organizations.deployment_note: No public robot model release as of Oct 2026
organizations.summary: AI lab that disbanded its original robotics team in 2021 and began rebuilding robotics/hardware efforts in 2024, hiring former Meta AR hardware lead Caitlin Kalinowski; investor in Physical Intelligence.

sources.label: TechCrunch: Kalinowski joins OpenAI to lead robotics & consumer hardware (Nov 2024)

organizations.name: Meta (FAIR robotics)
organizations.subsegment: Embodied AI research (world models, tactile sensing)
organizations.summary: Meta's FAIR lab conducts embodied AI research including the V-JEPA 2 world model used for zero-shot robot planning.

organizations.name: Microsoft Research
organizations.summary: Microsoft Research released Magma, an open multimodal foundation model for digital and robotic agents (Feb 2025).

organizations.name: Amazon (Robotics / Frontier AI & Robotics)
organizations.ai_approach: Fleet foundation model (DeepFleet); robot foundation models via FAR team
organizations.summary: Amazon operates one of the largest robot fleets and in 2024 formed a Frontier AI & Robotics team after hiring Covariant's founders under a licensing deal.

organizations.name: World Labs
organizations.funding_note: ~$230M across two rounds (2024) + $1B (Feb 2026, valuation undisclosed; Autodesk $200M) — press-reported
organizations.summary: Fei-Fei Li's San Francisco startup building large world models for spatial intelligence; its first product Marble generates 3D worlds from text or images.

organizations.name: Genesis AI
organizations.ai_approach: Synthetic data from proprietary physics engine
organizations.funding_note: $105M seed co-led by Eclipse and Khosla (Jul 2025)
organizations.summary: Physical AI lab (Palo Alto/Paris) founded by Zhou Xian and Théophile Gervet that supports the open-source Genesis simulator and builds a general-purpose robotics foundation model.

organizations.name: Open Robotics (OSRF)
organizations.summary: Nonprofit Open Source Robotics Foundation that stewards ROS 2 and Gazebo; its commercial arm was acquired by Intrinsic in Dec 2022 and it launched the Open Source Robotics Alliance in 2024.

organizations.name: Foxglove
organizations.funding_note: $40M Series B led by Bessemer (Nov 2025); >$58M total (company-reported)
organizations.summary: San Francisco data and observability platform for robotics teams (multimodal log visualization and data management).

organizations.name: Viam
organizations.funding_note: $30M Series C led by Union Square Ventures (Mar 2025); $117M total
organizations.summary: New York software platform for building, deploying and managing robots and smart machines, founded by MongoDB co-founder Eliot Horowitz.

organizations.name: Formant
organizations.funding_note: $6M seed (2018) + $18M Series A led by SignalFire (Jan 2022); later rounds unconfirmed
organizations.summary: San Francisco cloud platform for monitoring, teleoperating and analyzing heterogeneous robot fleets.

organizations.name: InOrbit
organizations.funding_note: $2.6M seed (2020) + ~$10M Series A co-led by L'ATTITUDE Ventures and Globant Ventures (Sep 2025)
organizations.summary: Mountain View robot operations platform for orchestrating and monitoring multi-vendor robot fleets.

organizations.name: Applied Intuition
organizations.subsegment: Simulation & autonomy software for vehicles and machines
organizations.funding_note: $600M Series F & tender at $15B (Jun 2025) co-led by BlackRock funds and Kleiner Perkins; $250M Series E (Mar 2024)
organizations.summary: Mountain View company providing simulation, autonomy and vehicle-software tools for automotive, trucking, defense and other moving machines.

organizations.name: Scale AI
organizations.subsegment: Robotics training data (Physical AI Data Engine)
organizations.funding_note: Meta took a ~49% stake for ~$14.3B in Jun 2025 (widely reported)
organizations.summary: San Francisco data company that launched a Data Engine for Physical AI (Sep 2025) collecting and annotating robot demonstration data.

sources.label: Scale blog: Physical AI data engine

organizations.name: Encord
organizations.subsegment: Multimodal data platform for physical AI
organizations.funding_note: $60M Series C led by Wellington Management (Feb 2026); $110M total
organizations.summary: London/San Francisco AI data management and annotation platform increasingly focused on physical AI (robotics, AV) customers.

organizations.name: Tutor Intelligence
organizations.ai_approach: Central robot intelligence platform with human-in-the-loop
organizations.funding_note: $34M Series A led by Union Square Ventures (Dec 2025); ~$42M total
organizations.summary: MIT spinout providing AI-powered warehouse robot workers on subscription, trained via a central robot intelligence platform.

organizations.name: Ai2 (Allen Institute for AI)
organizations.summary: Seattle nonprofit AI institute that released MolmoAct, an open action reasoning model for robotics (Aug 2025).

organizations.name: PickNik Robotics
organizations.summary: Boulder, CO company behind the open-source MoveIt motion-planning framework and the commercial MoveIt Pro platform.

organizations.name: Brain Corp
organizations.summary: San Diego company whose BrainOS autonomy platform powers commercial floor scrubbers and inventory-scanning robots.

organizations.name: Plus One Robotics
organizations.subsegment: Vision software for parcel picking with remote human-in-the-loop
organizations.summary: San Antonio company providing AI vision software for robotic parcel handling with remote human-in-the-loop assistance.

organizations.name: Osaro
organizations.summary: San Francisco company developing machine-learning software for robotic piece-picking and e-commerce fulfillment.

organizations.name: Polymath Robotics
organizations.summary: San Francisco startup offering a general autonomy software layer for industrial off-road vehicles.

organizations.name: Robust.AI
organizations.subsegment: Collaborative mobile robots with AI software
organizations.summary: San Carlos, CA company co-founded by Rodney Brooks building AI software and the Carter collaborative mobile robot for warehouses.

organizations.name: Duality Robotics
organizations.summary: Digital-twin simulation company whose Falcon platform generates synthetic data and tests autonomy for robots and off-road systems.

organizations.name: Parallel Domain
organizations.summary: Synthetic data platform generating simulated camera, lidar and radar data for training and testing perception in autonomous systems.

organizations.name: Bifrost AI
organizations.summary: Synthetic 3D data generation company for training vision models in autonomous and robotic systems (defense, maritime, aerial).

organizations.name: Teleo
organizations.subsegment: Supervised autonomy / teleoperation kits for heavy equipment
organizations.summary: Palo Alto company converting existing construction and mining equipment into remotely operated, supervised-autonomous robots.

organizations.name: Mbodi AI
organizations.subsegment: Agentic AI layer for training robots via natural language
organizations.summary: New York startup building an AI layer that lets industrial robots be taught new tasks through natural-language interaction.

models.name: RT-1 (Robotics Transformer 1)
models.capabilities: Transformer policy trained on ~130k real-world episodes from Everyday Robots mobile manipulators across 700+ tasks.

models.name: RT-2
models.capabilities: Early vision-language-action model co-fine-tuning web-scale VLMs (PaLI-X, PaLM-E) to output robot actions as tokens.

models.name: AutoRT
models.capabilities: System using LLM/VLM orchestration to direct fleets of robots for large-scale in-the-wild data collection with a robot constitution for safety.

models.name: Open X-Embodiment (RT-X)
models.capabilities: Pooled dataset of 1M+ trajectories from 22 robot embodiments contributed by 21 institutions, with RT-1-X/RT-2-X models.

models.name: Gemini Robotics
models.capabilities: Gemini 2.0-based VLA for general, interactive and dexterous manipulation; adapted to bi-arm and humanoid embodiments.

models.name: Gemini Robotics-ER
models.capabilities: Embodied-reasoning VLM with enhanced spatial understanding (pointing, 3D detection, grasp/trajectory prediction) for robot controllers.

models.name: Gemini Robotics On-Device
models.capabilities: Local, low-latency version of Gemini Robotics VLA that runs on the robot and can be fine-tuned with 50–100 demonstrations.

models.name: Gemini Robotics 1.5
models.capabilities: VLA that 'thinks before acting' and transfers motions across embodiments; paired with Gemini Robotics-ER 1.5 for agentic multi-step tasks.

models.name: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.5
models.capabilities: Embodied-reasoning model for spatial understanding, planning and tool calling; first Gemini Robotics model generally available to developers via the Gemini API (preview).

models.name: Genie 3
models.capabilities: General-purpose interactive world model generating navigable environments in real time from text prompts; positioned for training embodied agents.

models.name: MuJoCo
models.capabilities: Physics engine for contact-rich robot simulation; acquired by DeepMind in 2021 and open-sourced under Apache 2.0 in 2022.

models.name: MuJoCo Playground
models.capabilities: GPU-accelerated library of environments (locomotion, manipulation, classic control) for RL and sim-to-real transfer, e.g. Unitree G1, Franka Panda.

models.name: ALOHA
models.capabilities: Low-cost open-source bimanual teleoperation hardware with the ACT (Action Chunking with Transformers) imitation learning policy.

models.name: Mobile ALOHA
models.capabilities: Low-cost whole-body teleoperation system and co-training recipe for bimanual mobile manipulation.

models.name: π0
models.capabilities: Flow-matching VLA built on a PaliGemma VLM, pretrained on cross-embodiment data; weights released via openpi (Feb 2025).

models.name: π0-FAST
models.capabilities: Autoregressive variant of π0 using the FAST frequency-space action tokenizer for faster training.

models.name: π0.5
models.capabilities: VLA with improved open-world generalization (e.g. cleaning unseen homes) via co-training on heterogeneous data; weights added to openpi Sep 2025.

models.name: π*0.6
models.capabilities: π0.6-based VLA improved with Recap, an RL-from-experience method using demonstrations, corrections and autonomous rollouts.

models.name: Isaac GR00T N1
models.capabilities: Open foundation model for generalist humanoid robots with a dual-system (VLM + diffusion transformer action) architecture.

models.name: Isaac GR00T N1.5
models.capabilities: Updated GR00T model with improved language following and data efficiency, trained partly on synthetic GR00T-Dreams data.

models.name: Isaac GR00T N1.6
models.capabilities: GR00T release using an Eagle VLM backbone; listed under previous releases (n1d6 branch). Release month not confirmed.

models.name: Isaac GR00T N1.7
models.capabilities: Current GA GR00T release using a Cosmos-Reason2-2B (Qwen3-VL) backbone and 20K hours of human video in pretraining; available as a LeRobot policy.

models.name: NVIDIA Cosmos (world foundation models)
models.capabilities: Family of open world foundation models — Predict (future video), Transfer (sim-to-real style transfer), Reason (physical reasoning VLM) — for synthetic data and physical AI.

models.name: NVIDIA Isaac Sim
models.capabilities: Omniverse-based robot simulator with GPU physics, RTX sensor rendering, URDF/MJCF import and synthetic data generation; source on GitHub under Apache 2.0.

models.name: NVIDIA Isaac Lab
models.capabilities: GPU-accelerated framework (successor to Orbit) for robot RL, imitation learning and motion planning; v3.0 supports kit-less Newton workflows.

models.name: NVIDIA Isaac ROS
models.capabilities: Collection of GPU-accelerated ROS 2 packages (perception, VSLAM, nvblox, cuMotion) for NVIDIA Jetson and GPUs.

models.name: NVIDIA Omniverse
models.capabilities: OpenUSD-based platform for building physically based digital twins and simulation applications; foundation of Isaac Sim.

models.name: Newton physics engine
models.capabilities: GPU-accelerated physics engine built on NVIDIA Warp with MuJoCo Warp as primary backend; initiated by Disney Research, Google DeepMind and NVIDIA; Linux Foundation project.

models.name: OpenVLA
models.capabilities: 7B-parameter open VLA built on Prismatic (DINOv2+SigLIP, Llama 2) trained on 970k Open X-Embodiment trajectories.

models.name: Octo
models.capabilities: Open-source transformer diffusion policy pretrained on 800k Open X-Embodiment trajectories, fine-tunable to new robots.

models.name: DROID dataset
models.capabilities: Large in-the-wild manipulation dataset (~76k trajectories, 350 hours, 564 scenes) collected on a shared Franka Panda platform by 13 institutions.

models.name: LeRobot
models.capabilities: Open-source PyTorch library for end-to-end robot learning: datasets format, imitation/RL policies (ACT, Diffusion, VLAs) and low-cost hardware support.

models.name: SmolVLA
models.capabilities: Compact (~450M-parameter) open VLA trained on community LeRobot datasets, designed to run on consumer hardware.

models.name: Helix
models.capabilities: Generalist VLA with a fast visuomotor 'System 1' and VLM 'System 2' providing full upper-body humanoid control, running on onboard GPUs.

models.name: Redwood AI
models.capabilities: 1X's onboard AI model for the NEO humanoid enabling mobile manipulation and household tasks.

models.name: 1X World Model
models.capabilities: Learned world model that simulates EVE/NEO humanoid first-person observations for policy evaluation; public challenge dataset of 100+ hours.

models.name: Skild Brain
models.capabilities: Embodiment-agnostic robot foundation model for locomotion and manipulation across robot types.

models.name: Field Foundation Models (FFMs)
models.capabilities: Risk-aware embodied AI models enabling robots to navigate and operate without maps/GPS in unstructured environments (construction, energy, mining).

models.name: TRI Large Behavior Models
models.capabilities: Diffusion-policy-based multitask manipulation models; 2025 study showed LBM pretraining reduces data needed for new tasks.

sources.label: arXiv 2507.05331: A Careful Examination of LBMs

models.name: Diffusion Policy
models.capabilities: Visuomotor policy learning method representing actions as a conditional denoising diffusion process (Columbia, TRI, MIT).

models.name: UMI (Universal Manipulation Interface)
models.capabilities: Handheld gripper data-collection system enabling in-the-wild demonstrations transferable to robot policies (Stanford, Columbia, TRI).

models.name: RFM-1
models.capabilities: 8B-parameter multimodal robotics foundation model trained on warehouse pick data, text, images and video.

models.name: V-JEPA 2 / V-JEPA 2-AC
models.capabilities: Self-supervised video world model; action-conditioned V-JEPA 2-AC enables zero-shot reach/grasp/pick-and-place planning from image goals on a Franka arm.

models.name: V-JEPA 2.1
models.capabilities: Successor family learning dense, temporally consistent video features; checkpoints from 80M to 2B parameters.

models.name: Magma
models.capabilities: 8B multimodal agentic foundation model for UI navigation and robot manipulation planning (research use).

models.name: ROS 2
models.capabilities: Open-source robotics middleware (DDS-based) with tools and libraries; de facto standard robot software framework.

models.name: Gazebo
models.capabilities: Open-source robot simulator (successor to Gazebo Classic, formerly Ignition) with ROS 2 integration.

models.name: Genesis / Genesis World
models.capabilities: Multi-physics simulation platform (rigid, FEM, MPM, SPH, IPC) with Python API; started as academic project Dec 2024, Genesis World 1.0 in May 2026.

models.name: Intrinsic Flowstate
models.capabilities: Web-based development environment for building, simulating and deploying industrial robot applications.

models.name: DYNA-1
models.capabilities: Commercial robot foundation model for high-throughput, long-duration tasks such as napkin folding.

models.name: Marble
models.capabilities: Multimodal world model product generating persistent, editable 3D worlds from text, images or video.

models.name: DeepFleet
models.capabilities: Foundation model coordinating movement of Amazon's warehouse robot fleet; Amazon reports ~10% improvement in fleet travel efficiency.

models.name: MolmoAct
models.capabilities: Open action reasoning model that plans in 3D (depth-aware tokens, visual trajectory) before producing actions.

models.name: Viam platform
models.capabilities: Cloud + on-device software platform (open-source RDK) for configuring, controlling, collecting data and deploying ML on robots.

models.name: Formant platform
models.capabilities: Cloud platform for observability, teleoperation and analytics of heterogeneous robot fleets.

models.name: InOrbit RobOps platform
models.capabilities: Robot operations and multi-vendor orchestration platform for fleet monitoring, incident management and analytics.
